authority: Latest user direction; coordinator supplies research, art references and creative decisions. Specialists program and verify.

visual_contract.standard: Reproduce the approved concept; improvement alone does not establish acceptance.
visual_contract.geometry: Polygonal navigable rooms with shared collision are authorized.
visual_contract.materials: Use original approved material pixels, not substitute generated textures.
visual_contract.composition: Asymmetric C3 and Bio Wing containment piers, left infestation and advancing melee silhouette, broad rear stair and gate, right yellow-green specimen tanks and ranged threat, overhead services, scuffed reflective metal and dark grates.
visual_contract.hud: Preserve the current HUD; user says it looks alright.
visual_contract.audio: Preserve praised music; Abelian menu only. Dry weapon/material impacts, pain sounds and bloodcurdling death vocals; no wet damage audio.
visual_contract.review: Display original concept and actual gameplay with honest labels. User visual approval is still pending.

story_draft.status: Coordinator draft for later revision; no campaign is implemented by this document.
story_draft.premise: A municipal recovery worker enters a sealed research district to restore the evacuation line. The Pale Ward's treatment network is carrying an organism through the city's machinery. Every apparent containment system is keeping something alive.
story_draft.player_objective: Recover the ward's suppression core and reopen the route out; discover why the signal continues below the facility.
